name: token-monitor
description: Live token & cost widget for Claude Code, Codex & Hermes — local-first, optional multi-device sync.

scripts.pack:mac:widget: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-arm64 && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --dir
scripts.pack:mac:widget:x64: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-x64 --allow-missing-target-package && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --dir --config.directories.output=dist/mac-x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:widget: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-arm64 && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:widget:x64: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=darwin-x64 && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=win32-x64 && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run ensure:tokscale -- --platform=linux-x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --linux --x64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: Live token & cost widget for AI coding tools
linux.description: Real-time token, cost, and AI limits widget with multi-device sync for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more.

author: Javis
